about: Contract scenarios for the document requests: replayed against the fake document (agent/bridge/test/contract.test.mjs) and against the extension's handlers in a headless Aseprite (agent/tests/contract_test.lua). Both runners must pass every scenario.
Each *.json file next to this one holds { scenarios: [...] }. A scenario: name, notes?, legend? (extra pixel keys), fixture, steps.
Pixels are rows of one-character keys: '.' is transparent, the rest come from the legend below (plus the scenario's legend).

fixture: title?, width, height, colorMode? (rgb | indexed | grayscale), durations? (ms per frame, default [100]), palette? (default ['#000000', '#ffffff']), layers (top first, as in the timeline): [{ name, visible?, group?, layers? (a group's children, top first), cels?: { '<frame>': rows | { x, y, rows } } }], tags?: [{ name, from, to, direction? }], slices?: [{ name, x, y, w, h, center?: { x, y, w, h } }], selection?: { x, y, w, h }, activeLayer? (name; default the first image layer from the top), activeFrame? (default 1). Indexed fixtures use palette colors other than index 0 (the transparent index).

Steps run in order: { request, params, result?, error? } sends a wire request; { pixels: { layer?, frame? }, rows } compares a snapshot; { state } compares the normalized get_state. In params, { rows: [...] } (for rgba) is encoded as base64 RGBA and { $id: name } becomes that layer's id.

Normalized state: title (filename), width, height, colorMode, durations, activeFrame, activeLayer (name), layers (top first: name, visible, group, cels (frames with a cel), links (groups of frames whose cels are linked, as get_state's celLinks), tilemap, opacity, blendMode, fx (an effect record: id, x, y, fps, loop, windupMs, recipe?, render?), layers), tags (name, from, to, direction), palette (hex), slices (as get_state: name, bounds, center), selection, hits (get_state's fxHits: frame, freezeMs, shakeMs, amp).

Matching: objects compare only the keys the expectation lists; arrays compare length and every item; { $set: [...] } is an array in any order; { $layerId: name } is the id of the layer with that name; { $absent: true } is a missing value. error is a substring of the error message.

fakeUnsupported: reason, on a step the fake does not model. The fake must throw 'fake document: ... not supported' there, and its runner stops the scenario; Aseprite runs the step (and the rest) normally.
